WITH ranked AS ( SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN `submission` s ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.username HAVING totalSubmissions > 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked
username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.bio AS bio, u.roles AS roles, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.question_id END) AS solvedCount, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) AS acSubmissions, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(s.id), 0), 1) AS acceptRate, 0 AS totalScore, MAX(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.created_at END) AS lastAcceptedAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.question_id END) DESC, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) DESC, COUNT(s.id) ASC, MAX(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.created_at END) ASC, u.id ASC ) AS `rank` FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN `submission` s ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.bio, u.roles HAVING totalSubmissions > 0 ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE userId = #{userId}

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.bio AS bio, u.roles AS roles, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.question_id END) AS solvedCount, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) AS acSubmissions, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(s.id), 0), 1) AS acceptRate, 0 AS totalScore, MAX(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.created_at END) AS lastAcceptedAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.question_id END) DESC, COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 END) DESC, COUNT(s.id) ASC, MAX(CASE WHEN s.status = 'ACCEPTED' THEN s.created_at END) ASC, u.id ASC ) AS `rank` FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN `db_submission` s ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.bio, u.roles HAVING totalSubmissions > 0 ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE userId = #{userId}

WITH ranked AS ( SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, COUNT(s.id) AS totalSubmissions FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN `objective_submission` s ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.username HAVING totalSubmissions > 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked
username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')

WITH per_question AS ( SELECT user_id, question_id, MAX(score) AS best_score, MAX(CASE WHEN correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_solved, COUNT(id) AS sub_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN correct = 1 THEN 1 END) AS ac_count, MAX(CASE WHEN correct = 1 THEN created_at END) AS last_ac_at FROM `objective_submission` GROUP BY user_id, question_id ), ranked AS ( SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.bio AS bio, u.roles AS roles, COALESCE(SUM(pq.is_solved), 0) AS solvedCount, COALESCE(SUM(pq.best_score), 0) AS totalScore, COALESCE(SUM(pq.sub_count), 0) AS totalSubmissions, COALESCE(SUM(pq.ac_count), 0) AS acSubmissions, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(pq.ac_count), 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(pq.sub_count), 0), 1) AS acceptRate, MAX(pq.last_ac_at) AS lastAcceptedAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(pq.is_solved), 0) DESC, COALESCE(SUM(pq.best_score), 0) DESC, COALESCE(SUM(pq.ac_count), 0) DESC, COALESCE(SUM(pq.sub_count), 0) ASC, MAX(pq.last_ac_at) ASC, u.id ASC ) AS `rank` FROM `user` u INNER JOIN per_question pq ON u.id = pq.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.bio, u.roles ) SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE userId = #{userId}
